end.parentNote: Asha practised place value and writing 4-digit numbers with zeros inside them. Diya used the example 4050 to notice that zeros hold empty place values, but mixed up 6007 and wrote only two digits; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise building numbers such as 4005, 6007, and 7080 with digit cards, saying each place aloud.
